dedupe_keys.name: harmonized iacs inventory europe land field level crop declarations from eu subsidy systems

description: This inventory harmonizes the Geospatial Aid application data of the EU Integrated Administration and Control System, which manages farm subsidies, into field-level annual land use. The Zenodo record says it covers 20 EU member states with series up to 18 years, giving the crop per field, and for seven member states or regions also a farm identifier or organic status, while Croatia and Lithuania are included from public parcel system data; data that GDPR does not allow to be shared are withheld. It was published by researchers at the Leibniz Institute of Agricultural Development in Transition Economies and the University of Copenhagen (version 1.3, February 2026) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as 75 zips by country and year, about 168 GB. Coverage is 20 EU member states or regions. Caveats: years and attributes differ by country, farm identifiers are rare, and some countries are missing for privacy. For simulation it gives declared crops per field over many years to model agricultural exposure and losses from drought, flood and heat. Related catalogue records include the EU field boundaries with crop types and the probabilistic crop type maps for the EU.
name: Harmonized IACS inventory (Europe-LAND) - field-level crop declarations from EU subsidy systems
provider: Leibniz Institute of Agricultural Development in Transition Economies (IAMO) and University of Copenhagen authors (Jänicke and others), via Zenodo
